claims.text: NEW PRIMARY VEHICLE. The text of Division M was submitted on the Senate floor by Sen. claims.text: The operative text of Sec. 1102 of Division M has NEVER been read verbatim. Six primary vehicles - govinfo HTML and PDF of S.2226es and S.2103rs, SSCI's engrossed PDF, and both formats of the Congressional Record granule - all fail at the same extraction ceiling. The 60-day deadline, the 'non-earth origin or exotic' language and the make-available-to-AARO mandate therefore rest on a secondary source describing REPORTED Sec. 1104, not engrossed Sec. 1102. This is a downgrade of the board's prior confidence, recorded rather than buried. The text was printed in full as SA 1053 at 169 Cong. Rec. S3628-S3642, which is the citation vehicle a future pass should use.
